STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-ANON.moves.run: Hehe, I am not giving up on AnonTokyo!
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-ANON.moves.die: ...I give up. It's all Tomori's fault anyway.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-ANON.moves.runLine2: I always ran the anchor leg in relay races for all 3 years of middle school!
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-ANON.moves.speakLine1: If I can grab the Top Star, I can become a dazzling superstar too!
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-ANON.moves.initSpeak: Heh heh, this time nobody can stop me from founding Anon Tokyo!
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-ANON.name: Anon Chihaya
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI.name: Taki Shiina
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI.moves.wait: Sorry. I never wanted to fight you.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI.moves.phaseOne: But only by taking the Top Star can I prove I'm better than that person...!
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI.moves.phaseTwo: I have reasons I can't back down either!
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI.moves.phaseTwoDie: As expected of you. But I still don't want to lose!
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI.moves.phaseThree: This is my full strength! Now let me hear your song!
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI.moves.run: ...In the end, I still can't bring myself to hurt you. That was a wonderful performance, Tomori.
STS2_TOMORIN_MOD-TAKI.moves.die: As expected of you, Tomori. I lost, but right now I'm happy...!
